strings.mdKbSmart: • Smart keybox fetch: awayih uddur keybox Google's lowsis list (CRL) lih lowsis abak mango raceenaanih lowsis abak, automatic backup kee Google ayfaafayitteh lowsis abak, lowsis abak geytima. kulli bummul yardem kee interneet faxa (1-3 minit).

strings.mdRkpDiag: • RKP fokkaaqoh: geytimta Remote Key Provisioning modules wagsiisak, TEE diggoysiyyih certificate wagsiisak, KmInstallKeybox aalat elle yan caddo wagsiisak. Tu ma milaagta — qaduuk yahaazih caalat mabul.
strings.mdWvDiag: • Widevine cubbus (akriyiyya dubuk): Widevine caddoh ascossi (L1/L3) dumpsys, DRM (IDM) key-fayil geytimam, kee sissin sissinaaneh qaynat wagsiisak. Inkih tu mayaysiisa.
strings.mdRkpManual: • Gaayimat RKP massos: arda sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh gaayimat. massos sumaq caagid sissikuk tatur rade wak. Kulli arda qado mayso/nikso firta yatbiqe.
strings.mdRkpFull: • Kibne RKP massos: arda sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh kibne. Gibdi caagiida yabbixem kee mango wakti beele. Qado xali ellecabol yanbulle.
strings.mdGmsReset: • Qagitaak GMS: Play Store kee Google ayfaafayitteh (GMS+GSF) oytitte qaddoysaanam kee sissikuk aalat qimmisaanam. Dubuk gibdi sumaqtah — ku foto kee faayil inkinah maxaga.
strings.mdCertify: • Digir sumaqta: RKP sumaqtah caalat wagsiisak, faxximtek sumaqtah uwwayti qagitak qimmisa. Xoqoysimah oyta maxaginna.
strings.mdSoter: • SOTER dammiyo: massos Google ayfaafay rakisso (SOTER) caagid celtam jahaaz sumaaqitte. dagoo yahaadal duqaysimak too elle rakittam SOTER aftok digir nummiino.
strings.mdPifApply: •Abbinos PIF: arda sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/apply_pif.sh cayla. meexen feerah asta abbinos ( dariifa/ naharal) kee pif.prop/pif.json faayilitteh uddurtisso. qado xali kutbeh addat yanbulle.
strings.mdPifCheck: • PIF cubbus: lowsis gubat yan motoorih caalat, feeraarih faylitte (custom.pif.prop/pif.prop), kee lowsis gubat yan lowsis. dubuk cubbus - toh tu mataysiisa.
